P R O F E S S I O N A L  S U M M A R Y  
 
Senior Business Analyst and Loan IQ Functional Consultant with 17+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Banking, 
Syndicated Lending, Investment Banking, and Capital Markets. Deep hands -on expertise in FINASTRA Fusion Loan IQ — 
covering the full loan lifecycle from Deal Setup and Facility Configuration to Drawdowns, Fee Processing, Interest Accrual, and 
Statutory Regulatory Reporting. Proven delivery record across global tier -1 institutions including ING Bank Netherlands, BNP 
Paribas, Credit Suisse, and BNY Mellon. Skilled in bridging business and technology through rigorous requirements gathering, 
end-to-end SDLC delivery, Agile/Scrum execution, and leading cross -functional offshore BA teams. Strong additional 
background in Market Risk, Liquidity Risk, and Regulatory Reporting (LCR, NSFR, COREP, FINREP, SiFi3). 
 
F I N A S T R A  L O A N  I Q  —  F U N C T I O N A L  E X P E R T I S E  
 
 
Core Loan IQ Modules & Functional Knowledge 
• Deal Setup & Configuration — Bilateral and Syndicated deal structures, multi-lender arrangements, agent 
and non-agent roles, deal amendment workflows, and deal-level accounting setup. 
• Facility Management — Revolving Credit Facilities (RCF), Term Loans (TL/TLA/TLB), Sub-limits, Swinglines, 
Letter of Credit (LC) facilities, facility fee configuration, and maturity management. 
• Outstandings & Drawdowns — Loan booking, drawdown processing, repayment scheduling, rollover 
management, prepayments, and maturity extensions across multi-currency portfolios. 
• Covers & Risk Participations — Funded and unfunded risk participation setup, cover management for 
syndicated and bilateral exposure, and counterparty risk tracking. 
• Fee Processing — Commitment fees, agency fees, upfront fees, utilisation fees, waiver fees, amendment 
fees — accrual and settlement workflows in Loan IQ. 
• Interest Accrual & Rate Setting — SOFR, EURIBOR, SONIA, LIBOR transition handling, base rate and spread 
configuration, interest period management, non-accrual processing, and rate reset workflows. 
• Loan Amendments & Restructuring — Covenant waiver processing, facility extension, repricing, lender 
transfers, and syndication changes. 
• Loan IQ Regulatory & Statutory Reporting — LCR, NSFR, SiFi3, COREP, FINREP reporting configured and 
validated via GFRS (Global Financial Reporting System) integration with Loan IQ data. 
• SWIFT & Payments Integration — MT103, MT202 payment message processing, agent notification handling, 
nostro reconciliation, and settlement workflows. 
• Data Architecture & SQL — Deep understanding of Loan IQ database schema, Oracle-SQL based GFRS 
architecture, data flow from Loan IQ to downstream reporting systems. 
• Testing & Release Management — BRD, FRD, FSD authoring; SIT, UAT, and regression testing per Loan IQ 
release cycle; defect triage and stakeholder sign-off facilitation. 
• Loan IQ Upgrades & Releases — Major release and patch release delivery, regression testing across 
functional modules, and change impact assessment.

• Deal Setup & Facility Configuration: Analyse and document requirements for deal creation, multi-lender syndication 
structures, facility types (RCF, Term Loans, Swinglines, LCs), sub -limit configurations, and lender share allocations 
within Loan IQ — ensuring accurate reflection of credit agreement terms. 
• Outstandings & Drawdown Management: Define and validate business requirements for loan drawdown processing, 
repayment schedules, rollovers, prepayments, and maturity extensions across multi -currency, multi-branch portfolios

• Covers & Risk Participations: Document and test funded and unfunded risk participation structures, cover setup for 
syndicated exposure management, and counterparty risk tracking workflows in Loan IQ.

facility extensions, repricing events, lender transfers, and syndication restructuring — documenting change impacts on 
Loan IQ configurations. 
• SWIFT & Payments Integration: Analyse and document payment processing requirements linking Loan IQ to SWIFT 
(MT103/MT202), agent notifications, nostro reconciliation, and settlement workflows.  
Statutory & Regulatory Reporting — GFRS / LCR / NSFR / COREP / FINREP 
• Lead business analysis for ING Bank's statutory and regulatory reporting tribe, covering local and head -office 
submissions across LCR, NSFR, SiFi3, COREP, FINREP, and Liquidity reporting requirements governed by EBA/ECB 
regulatory frameworks. 
• Manage end-to-end change delivery on GFRS (Global Financial Reporting System) — ING's Oracle-SQL based regulatory 
reporting platform — analysing how Loan IQ data flows into GFRS and ensuring regulatory calculations and 
submissions are accurate and complete. 
• Perform regression testing every GFRS release cycle, validating regulatory report outputs against expected results and 
ensuring zero-defect production deployment for mandatory regulatory submissions.  
• Conduct root-cause analysis on production regulatory reporting issues, identifying data discrepancies between Loan IQ 
source data and downstream GFRS reporting outputs, and delivering structured fix recommendations to IT and 
operations teams.
